help.text: Displays or changes file attributes. ATTRIB [+R|-R] [+H|-H] [path]
Displays the name of or changes the current directory.
Clears the screen.
Copies files. COPY A:\*.* [dest] uploads; COPY CON file types a new file (Ctrl+Z, Enter ends).
Deletes files. Wildcards allowed: DEL *.TXT (ERASE).
Deletes a directory and everything in it. DELTREE [/Y] path
Displays a list of files and subdirectories. DIR [path] [/A]
Displays a message. ECHO text > file writes it, >> appends it.
Opens a text file in the editor (creates it on save). Ctrl+S saves, Esc exits.
Quits the MS-DOS Prompt.
Provides help information for commands.
Signs in as administrator.
Signs out of the administrator session.
Creates a directory (MKDIR).
Moves files or renames directories. MOVE [/Y] source destination
Removes an empty directory (RMDIR).
Renames a file or directory. REN [path]oldname newname (RENAME)
Graphically displays the folder structure. TREE [path] [/F]
Displays the contents of a text file.
Displays the Windows version.
